commitResults.messageTitle: Document Codex assistance in Developer Guide

commitResults.messageBody:
Read-only commands previously saved the in-memory address book after
execution. An older app window could overwrite students added in a
newer window merely by listing tasks.

Save only when a command changes address-book data. Update rollback
tests for read-only commands while retaining failed-save coverage for
mutations.

A second app window can hold older student data while another window
saves newer records. A subsequent edit from the stale window would
replace the file and discard those newer records.

Retain the exact file contents used when loading and compare them
before each changed address book is saved. Hold a file lock across the
comparison and atomic replacement to prevent a concurrent save between
those steps. Roll back rejected commands and tell users to restart.

Update the user and developer guides for the new conflict behavior and
for read-only commands that no longer save.

commitResults.messageTitle: Bundle universal macOS JavaFX natives in release JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
The existing Shadow JAR contained Intel-only macOS JavaFX libraries,
so it could not start on Apple Silicon with a standard Java 25 JDK.

Resolve the ARM graphics artifact separately and combine matching native
libraries into universal Mach-O files during the build. Package those
files in place of the Intel-only copies while retaining the Windows and
Linux dependencies already included in the JAR.
Bundle universal macOS JavaFX natives in release JAR
Fix misleading expected result in DG manual-testing step 17

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept next lessons starting in the current minute
commitResults.messageBody:
Lesson times are entered as HH:mm, but the past check compared against the
current second, so booking the current minute was rejected as past.

commitResults.messageTitle: Report when clear finds no students to remove
commitResults.messageBody:
clear always reported that all students were removed, even when the list was
already empty. In a window with outdated data, this hid that another window's
students were still in the data file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Baaj9S3eBTv8SNwJ3E4GqW

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain when topic/ is not the last lesson parameter
commitResults.messageBody:
Text after topic/ is read as the topic, so putting topic/ before other
parameters hid them and nextlesson and recurringlesson only showed the generic
invalid-format error. Now they say that topic/ must be the last parameter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
